# Engage Youth Foundation

> Machine-readable site summary. Public content mirrors https://engage-youth.org.

## Organization
- Name: Engage Youth Foundation
- Type: US non-profit organization
- Mission: Engage, empower, and mobilize youth through programs, mentorship, and community projects (Pacific Northwest focus).

## Primary URLs
- [Home](https://engage-youth.org/)
- [About](https://engage-youth.org/about-us)
- [News & social](https://engage-youth.org/news-and-social-media)
- [Donation](https://engage-youth.org/donation)
- [Volunteer request](https://engage-youth.org/request-for-volunteer)
- [FAQ](https://engage-youth.org/faq)
- [Events (upcoming)](https://engage-youth.org/activities)
- [Past events](https://engage-youth.org/past-events)
- [Volunteer with us](https://engage-youth.org/volunteer-with-us)
- [Contact](https://engage-youth.org/contact-us)
- [Privacy](https://engage-youth.org/privacy-policy)

## Thematic pillars (homepage)
- Ecological sustainability
- Fighting homelessness
- Food drives and distribution
- Youth financial literacy

## Contact
- Use the Contact page form for inquiries: /contact-us

## Technical
- Stack: Next.js (App Router, static export), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Sanity CMS, Cloudflare Pages/Functions, Resend, Turnstile.
